standard-dialogue-before-starting-family.npc: I am so very tired... Leave me be... to rest...

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.npc: Hello again. My family now considers you a hero.
Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?

options.text: Can you change my gauntlets for me?

steps.player: Can you change my gauntlets for me?

steps.npc: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.

steps.text: Johnathon takes your gauntlets from you, and begins a low chant over them. You see them begin to glow and sparkle, before he returns them to you.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.npc: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.text: If this is the first time the player has talked to Johnathon after completing Family Pest:

steps.npc: If you want, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Chaos gauntlets as you wish to say thanks!

steps.text: Johnathon hands you a pair of Chaos gauntlets.

steps.npc: You will find the power of bolt spells increases substantially whilst wearing these gauntlets.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.text: If the player has already talked to Johnathon at least once after completing Family Pest:

options.text: Could I have some more chaos gauntlets, please?

steps.player: Could I have some more chaos gauntlets, please?

steps.text: How many would you like to take?
Johnathon hands you some chaos gauntlets.

steps.npc: You will find the power of bolt spells increases substantially whilst wearing these gauntlets.
